title: Invocation ancestry + token-funnel observability and dashboard
author: Miguel Santos
release_notes: Adds invocation ancestry tracing and a token-cost funnel dashboard. Includes an alert drift mitigator rule. Feature-flag gated; no API breakage.
description: Context: long-tail cost and latency regressions are hard to triage because trace ancestry, per-token cost signals, and rollout metadata live in different places. This PR introduces an invocation ancestry model at ingestion, emits compact per-invocation token-cost summaries, and surfaces a token-cost funnel dashboard that correlates route/model/prompt shape slices with ancestry heatmaps. It also adds a lightweight alert drift mitigator that suppresses noisy alerts when distribution shifts are explained by rollout tags. Implementation touches ingestion transformer, metric rollups, Grafana dashboard JSON, and alert rules. The feature is gated behind a runtime flag and rollout plan (48h staging, 10% prod for 72h, ramp over 7 days).
